generic_domain.justification: Neurology is a broader field that encompasses not only neuroanatomy but also the study of nervous system functions and disorders. Neuroanatomy specifically deals with the structure of the nervous system, while neurology includes the diagnosis and treatment of neurological conditions. Therefore,神经病学（neurology）能够包含神经解剖学的内容，同时涵盖更多临床方面和功能研究。
